details: A cliffside mining town in the Wildlands built above a massive chasm
Known for red stone quarries that produce valuable pigment
The legendary beast Tera sleeps deep in the chasm below; disturbances cause tremors
Recently freed from Moonshade Order presence after Vide's defeat
The inn is renowned across the realm for exceptional daytime service
Wind shears from the ravine create sudden whirlwinds on dusty streets
Currently experiencing a mysterious spreading sickness among residents

situations.next: If untreated, the illness will spread to more residents, potentially crippling the town's mining operations and forcing a quarantine that would devastate the local economy
situations.summary: A mysterious illness is spreading through Crackridge, causing fever, weakness, and respiratory distress. Nearly a dozen townspeople have fallen ill over the past three days, concentrated among miners and those who frequent the lower chasm areas. Local apothecary Tobias is overwhelmed and uncertain of the cause.
touches: Treat the spreading sickness in Crackridge
Identify the cause of the illness and prevent further spread

situations.next: Partitio will finalize negotiations with Marcus; if the deal succeeds, it will bring prosperity to Crackridge's miners and establish a new distribution network across Solistia
situations.summary: Partitio promised quarry foreman Marcus a fair supply contract for Crackridge's red stone pigments, ensuring miners receive proper compensation without exploitation. Marcus is cautious after years of being squeezed by outside merchants, but Partitio's reputation and generous offer have earned a meeting.
touches: Secure a supply contract for Crackridge's red stone pigments
Help the town recover economically from the sickness disrupting commerce

situations.next: Working alongside Castti during the crisis will reveal whether Tobias has the skill, temperament, and dedication required to join the reformed order
situations.summary: Tobias the apothecary, though overwhelmed by the current crisis, has shown dedication to his patients despite limited training. His humble plea for help and willingness to learn could make him an ideal candidate for Eir's Apothecaries if he proves capable and embraces their creed of extending a helping hand to all in need.
touches: Recruit capable healers to rebuild Eir's Apothecaries
